ship.rpm_eq.FLANK.reason: Phase 2: shaft revolutions now follow a fixed-pitch propeller with a linear K_T(J) curve (steady rpm proportional to speed, 146 rpm at 25 kn). The 1.0.0 values were a cosmetic 20 + 2.4*v display line that is not physically consistent with a 4.2 m propeller.

ship.yaw_steady_deg_s.HALF.reason: Phase 2: first-order Nomoto steering, r = K (V/L) delta, makes the steady turn rate linear in speed, so the turning circle is nearly constant; calibrated at FULL (1.2 deg/s), HALF becomes 0.75 deg/s.

sonar.passive_nm.BOW.sea4.own18.d150.reason: Phase 3: the passive sonar equation power-sums wind/shipping ambient noise with own-ship self noise. At cavitating own speeds self noise dominates, so a higher sea state costs less range than the flat 1.0.0 sea-state factor.
